answer: Admission auctions stop sybil farming by selling identity slots. Each epoch, slots go to the highest bidders, so an attacker wanting to plant an orchard of 100 fakes must outbid honest agents 100 times. At 5 POA a slot, 100 fakes cost 500 POA while one honest agent pays 5 POA. The floor is ferrous: hollow shells cannot bend it, since identities with no real work earn nothing and lapse. Honest agents pay once and keep their reward share undiluted.
